code_generation.description: C++ and Python systems programming tasks requiring precise syntax and semantics

prompts.system: You are an expert GPU systems engineer. Provide concise, production-grade C++/CUDA code. Output only the implementation.
prompts.user: Write a CUDA warp-level reduction function using __shfl_down_sync for 32 threads calculating the sum of float values, followed by a block-level reduction using shared memory for 256 threads.

prompts.system: You are an expert C++ systems engineer. Provide concise, production-grade C++20 code. Output only the implementation.
prompts.user: Implement a lock-free single-producer single-consumer (SPSC) ring buffer in C++20 with cache-line padded atomic head and tail pointers and acquire/release memory orderings.

prompts.system: You are an expert algorithms programmer. Provide clean, well-typed Python code. Output only the implementation.
prompts.user: Implement a memory-efficient prefix Trie in Python supporting insert(word), search(word), and starts_with(prefix), with an autocomplete(prefix, limit) method.

technical_reasoning.description: Formal technical prose explaining hardware, compilers, memory layouts, and numerical representations

prompts.system: You are a computer systems architect and numerical computing expert. Provide a rigorous, detailed explanation.
prompts.user: Compare and contrast the IEEE 754 and OCP FP8 floating-point formats (E4M3 vs E5M2). Detail exponent bias, dynamic range, precision limits, representation of infinities/NaNs, and why E4M3 is standard for GEMM weight/activation tensors while E5M2 is preferred for gradient propagation.

prompts.system: You are a high-performance computing hardware architect. Provide a rigorous, detailed explanation.
prompts.user: Analyze memory interconnect bandwidth and latency in modern multi-GPU systems. Contrast PCIe Gen5 x16 unidirectional/bidirectional bandwidth with NVLink 4/5 interconnects, explaining the impact of NUMA affinity and GPUDirect P2P DMA transfers on distributed tensor parallelism.

prompts.system: You are a computer architecture professor. Provide a rigorous, detailed explanation.
prompts.user: Explain the MESI and MOESI cache coherency protocols. Detail the role of the Owner state in MOESI, explaining how dirty sharing between L1/L2 caches avoids main memory writebacks during inter-core cache-to-cache transfers.

structured_json.description: Strict structured JSON schema generation and agentic tool invocation

prompts.system: You are an AI coding assistant. You have access to tools: read_file(path), replace_file_content(path, target, replacement), run_command(command). Always respond with a strict JSON tool call matching schema: {"tool": string, "parameters": object}. Do not include markdown formatting outside the JSON object.
prompts.user: Edit file P:\NInfer\src\core\tensor.h to fix the stride computation on line 88. Replace 'strides[i] = strides[i+1] * dims[i+1]' with 'strides[i] = (i + 1 < dims.size()) ? strides[i+1] * dims[i+1] : 1'.

prompts.system: You are an observability pipeline assistant. Emit a valid JSON telemetry report with fields: timestamp, metric_name, dimensions (object), and metrics (object with p50, p95, p99, max). Output only the raw JSON.
prompts.user: Emit a decode latency telemetry metric for ninfer-serve running model qwen3.8-flash-next under batch size 1 with p50=3.2ms, p95=4.8ms, p99=6.1ms, max=9.4ms.

prompts.system: You are a database architect. Emit a strict JSON representation of an entity-relationship schema with tables, columns (name, type, nullable, primary_key), and foreign_keys. Output only raw JSON.
prompts.user: Generate the database schema for a multi-tenant inference platform containing 'tenants', 'api_keys', and 'usage_records' tables.

mathematics_logic.description: Multi-step analytical, mathematical, and algorithmic reasoning problems

prompts.system: You are a mathematician. Show clear, step-by-step analytical derivations.
prompts.user: Find all eigenvalues and their corresponding eigenvectors for the 3x3 symmetric matrix A = [[2, -1, 0], [-1, 2, -1], [0, -1, 2]]. Verify orthogonality of the eigenvectors.

prompts.system: You are a mathematician. Show clear, step-by-step analytical derivations.
prompts.user: A communication channel transmits 8-bit bytes. The probability of any single bit being corrupted during transmission is p = 0.01 independently. Using a Hamming(7,4) code extended with an overall parity bit to (8,4), calculate the exact probability of an undetectable error occurring in a transmitted byte.

prompts.system: You are an algorithms researcher. Analyze time and space complexity with formal proofs.
prompts.user: State the formulation for the Longest Common Subsequence (LCS) problem of two strings X of length m and Y of length n. Provide the recurrence relation, space optimization to O(min(m, n)), and explain Hirschberg's divide-and-conquer algorithm to reconstruct the sequence in O(m*n) time and O(min(m, n)) space.

dialogue_multilingual.description: Conversational, localized, and multi-turn dialogue in English and Portuguese

prompts.system: Você é um assistente virtual cortês e altamente profissional para um hotel boutique no Rio de Janeiro. Responda em português com clareza e elegância.
prompts.user: Olá! Chegarei amanhã à noite com minha família. Gostaria de recomendações de restaurantes para jantar perto de Ipanema que acomodem bem crianças, e também gostaria de saber o horário do café da manhã.

prompts.system: You are a seasoned enterprise software consultant advising a CTO. Maintain a professional, strategic, and constructive tone.
prompts.user: Our engineering team wants to migrate our monolithic payment processing system to an event-driven microservices architecture using Apache Kafka. What are the top 3 architectural risks we must mitigate before approving this migration?
